some / any 与可数、不可数名词: some 多用于肯定句,any 多用于否定句和疑问句;可数名词有复数,不可数名词没有,many 配可数、much 配不可数。

可数名词有单复数:an apple → two apples|常见不可数名词:water, rice, money, paper, bread, milk|some 一般用于肯定句:I have some questions.|any 一般用于否定句和疑问句:I don't have any money.|表示请求或提议的疑问句用 some:Would you like some tea?|many + 可数名词复数;much + 不可数名词;how many / how much 分别对二者提问|a lot of / lots of 既可接可数名词也可接不可数名词
I have some questions about this lesson.
column3: 关于这一课我有一些问题。

some / any 与可数、不可数名词: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
How much money do you need for the book?
column3: 买这本书你需要多少钱?

# title: There are ___ apples in the basket on the table.
column4: 肯定句中用 some,apples 是可数名词复数。

# title: I don't have ___ money with me today.
column4: 否定句中用 any,而且 money 是不可数名词。

# title: Is there ___ water in the bottle?
Would you like ___ tea before dinner?
column4: 表示提议的疑问句用 some。

# title: How ___ books do you have in your bag?
column4: books 可数,提问用 how many。

# title: 下面哪个名词是不可数名词?
column4: rice(大米)不可数,没有复数形式。
